02
What you're holding

A workflow that follows your saved settings.

Supported scheduled tasks can generate, check and schedule passing Pins in Automatic mode, or prepare Pins for your approval in Review First, when the required connected actions are available. You supply authorized product inputs and choose Automatic or Review First during setup.

Amazon5 to 8 pieces per look, each with your own affiliate link
→
Pinteresttwo pins per look, 3 days apart, with your #ad line
→
Your listan Idea List, or a shop-the-look page on your own site

Automation 1 · Themed looks

The weekly workflow organizes your approved product inputs into look drafts, prepares images and Pin copy, and records the result. Automatic runs apply your saved authorization after every check passes. Review First asks you to choose each Pin. Destination and publishing depend on verified connections.

Automation 2 · Outfit of the Day

Optional: for members with the required Brand Closet™ access, the OOTD workflow can prepare new outfit drafts using your own authorized product inputs and images. Account access and each publishing step must be confirmed.

The honest part. Runs depend on the ChatGPT Work mode and connected actions available in your account. Cloud execution may run while your computer is off when supported; local execution requires your computer during a run. Automatic uses your setup authorization; Review First asks for each Pin. Pull or cancellation depends on the publishing connection.

What it doesn't promise: sales. Pinterest is search, and pins get found over weeks and months. This builds and runs the machine. What people buy is up to them and Amazon.

Step 0 · before anything

What you need, up front.

Choose a connected workflow or a manual workflow. Work and connected actions are optional for manual preparation. Full detail is in 01_REQUIREMENTS.txt.

  • For automated runs: a ChatGPT plan with Work and Scheduled Tasks availableFeature availability varies by account and workspace. Confirm Scheduled Tasks and the required connected actions in your own account before setup.
  • A supported execution mode and an available workspace or folderUse only the connected services and actions the setup confirms are available. Complete sign-in through each service's own sign-in flow.
  • Amazon Associates, plus Influencer approval for Idea ListsNo Influencer approval? The Associates-only path uses a page on your own site, and on most site builders you paste it in yourself.
  • A Pinterest business account and a verified public production boardUse a supported authorized path to resolve and confirm the exact board. If it cannot be verified, do not schedule.
  • Only for the optional blog half: a supported GitHub connectionWith write access to your site's repository; availability depends on your setup.
  • A connected image provider, if you choose that pathUse the provider and model confirmed available in your account. Record commercial-use rights; do not silently switch models or plans.
  • Optional: authorized Brand Closet™ lesson accessCheck the current listing and actual classroom entitlement before upgrading.

You don't need a website (unless you choose the Associates-only path or the blog half), Instagram, design skills, code, or your face on camera.

Steps 1 to 3

Choose your setup and accounts.

1

Choose a supported workspace

Follow the setup prompt to choose Cloud or Local only if that mode is available in your account. Use the dedicated connected Drive folder or local folder that the setup confirms can store your files. Unzip the kit there if your selected workflow requires it.

Save credits. Lower-cost: use ChatGPT or Claude to prepare files as text. Manual: save the kit and state/log files in a folder you control; no connected storage is required.

2

Connect only the services you choose

Complete sign-in through Amazon, Pinterest, your selected publisher, image provider, and storage service when prompted. Never type passwords into a task. The setup is incomplete if a required action is unavailable; use a supported manual path where the kit describes one.

Save credits. Lower-cost: ask ChatGPT or Claude for a checklist. Manual: sign in through each service yourself and copy only authorized inputs into your files.

3

Optional: join The Brand Closet™

Only if you want the optional Outfit of the Day workflow. Check the current listing and your actual lesson entitlement; a historical price or free membership does not prove lesson access.

Join The Brand Closet™ and confirm the selected execution mode can access the authorized lesson list.

Affiliate link: I earn a commission if you upgrade, at no extra cost to you.

Save credits. Lower-cost: describe the authorized outfit in your own words for ChatGPT or Claude. Manual: inspect your entitled lesson yourself; never upload member images or copy paid prompts.

05
Steps 4 and 5 · guided setup

Paste one prompt. Make your setup choices.

4

Open a ChatGPT Work chat

Start a new Work chat where the kit is available. Follow the setup prompt to connect the supported storage location and authorize the actions you choose. If Work, Scheduled Tasks, or a required write action is unavailable, stop setup and use only the supported manual path.

Save credits. Lower-cost: open a standard ChatGPT or Claude chat and choose the manual path. Manual: fill the setup choices in your own recipe file.

5

Paste the setup prompt

Open 02_SETUP_PROMPT.txt. Copy everything between the two long lines. Paste it into the chat and press Enter. The prompt collects the choices needed for your setup, including:

  1. your execution and publishing modes, if available
  2. your theme, boards, sections, and Amazon destination path
  3. your image provider and persona choices
  4. optional Brand Closet™ access and workflow
  5. your time zone, pace, and schedule
  6. connection checks, board verification, and required setup details for your selected path

Then it writes your recipe, structured state and readable views into the folder: MY_RECIPE.txt, storefront-log.md, pin-tab.md, pin-drafts.md, MY_SCHEDULED_TASKS.txt (plus a pages folder if you paste pages into your site yourself).

Save credits. Lower-cost: ask ChatGPT or Claude to return recipe and logs as text. Manual: copy and save those files yourself; no write connection is required.

Save your files, then check the actual connections you selected. Setup time depends on your accounts and choices.

06
Steps 6 and 7 · never scheduled a task? start here

Hand it the timetable.

6

Create your scheduled tasks

Setup creates and reads back MY_SCHEDULED_TASKS.txt with your selected prompts, schedules, state location and actual scheduler IDs. Configure only tasks supported by your account and setup choices. Each has one line telling you exactly what to type. For each one:

  1. Use the current supported scheduler in your selected Work or desktop local chat. Confirm the saved schedule and state location; a separate run must prove actual execution.
  2. Type the name from the file.
  3. Set the schedule from the file (for example: weekly, Saturday, 1:05 pm).
  4. Give it access to the configured state location only if the task's supported setup requires it.
  5. Paste the prompt: everything between that task's two long lines.
  6. Save.

Available menus and actions vary by account. If Scheduled Tasks or a required action is missing, do not claim the automation is active.

Save credits. Lower-cost: run the recipe on demand in ChatGPT or Claude. Manual: use your own calendar reminder and checklist; leave task installation off.

7

Watch the first run

Run a supported task once only after setup and required permissions are confirmed. Review the draft image, product fidelity, title, disclosure, alt text, destination, exact public board and state record. A successful first run does not prove future runs or publishing; monitor the account and report failures.

Save credits. Lower-cost: have ChatGPT or Claude check your copy and checklist. Manual: inspect the actual asset and destination yourself and record the result before authorizing any schedule.

Steps 8 to 10 · living with it

Choose how it runs.

8

Know what your selected mode requires

Cloud runs may work while your computer is off when Cloud Work and the required connected actions are enabled for your account. Local runs require your computer and any required local session to be available. Do not assume a missed run will catch up automatically; check the run record and report skipped work.

Save credits. Lower-cost: review recorded state on demand with ChatGPT or Claude. Manual: check your calendar and queue yourself; record and resume only unfinished work.

9

Automatic or Review First

Choose Automatic during setup and authorize the accounts, boards, destinations, model, budget, pace and channels once. Passing outputs are scheduled within those settings without repeated ordinary approvals. Review First retains exact per-Pin approval. See page 14 for the complete authorization and recovery rules.

Save credits. Lower-cost: prepare a review packet in ChatGPT or Claude. Manual: inspect each Pin in your own Pinterest interface, approve the exact asset and schedule it yourself; record scheduling separately from publication.

Optional extras

09_THE_BLOG_HALF.txt: a shop-the-look section on your own site, written for Google. 05_RECOMMEND_IT_TOO.txt: a Brand Closet™ card for your pages. 10_INSTAGRAM_ADD_ON.txt: feed posts (stories are by hand).

Save credits. Lower-cost: draft page sections and captions in ChatGPT or Claude. Manual: paste into your site, create feed posts in your own supported interface and add Stories in the app; review all disclosures.

Before the system schedules

Check the actual image, product fidelity or inspiration label, headline, destination, exact public board/section, disclosure, title and alt text. Automatic records a fresh approval fingerprint under your saved policy after all checks pass. Review First asks you to authorize the exact Pin. Changed output must be checked again. Record scheduling only after confirmation; publication requires separate evidence. Full production alternatives and checks are on pages 12 and 13.

10
When something's off

What the tasks do when things go wrong.

Pinterest loads blank

If a required page or action is unavailable, preserve affected work, record the limitation and continue independent eligible stages. Resume only from recorded state; do not promise an automatic retry or catch-up.

A connection is unavailable

If a required connected account or action is unavailable, stop the affected work, preserve completed records, and report what needs attention. Never request or enter passwords in a task.

A board went secret

Verify the exact board through an authorized supported path before scheduling. If public status cannot be verified, schedule nothing.

A run was missed

Check the scheduler and state record. Resume from recorded work, avoid duplicates, and report skipped items. Do not promise automatic recovery until the customer's workflow has demonstrated it.

You want to remove a Pin

Use the removal action supported by the selected publisher. If it is already published and the publisher cannot remove it, remove it in Pinterest and record the confirmed result.

An image comes out wrong

Follow the kit's defined image-attempt limit. If framing, required pieces, or product fidelity still fail, drop the look and record why. Add the headline only after the visual acceptance checks pass.

Reports must state what was drafted, approved, scheduled, and verified, and identify any action that still needs you.

Production choices

Save credits at every production step.

Product intakeConnected: use customer-supplied rows or an authorized Amazon integration. Lower-cost: ChatGPT or Claude organizes your own approved facts. Manual: find products yourself, capture your authorized links and record ASIN, facts, date and rights. Never invent links.
Idea List / shop pageConnected: only a supported authorized write path. Lower-cost: draft list titles or page copy in ChatGPT or Claude. Manual: edit your Idea List yourself, or paste an Associates shop page into your site.
Image / personaConnected: the configured provider with authorized budget. Lower-cost: prepare prompts in ChatGPT or Claude and run your selected provider directly within its limits. Manual: arrange original or permitted imagery yourself. Only use a persona reference you may use; do not promise identity preservation on an unsupported model.
Headline / layoutConnected: an available deterministic layout editor. Lower-cost: ask ChatGPT or Claude for headline text. Manual: add text in an editor you already use, then check spelling, legibility and margins. Do not buy a plan just to follow this step.
Copy / schedulingConnected: selected publisher after saved-policy authorization in Automatic, or exact per-Pin approval in Review First. Lower-cost: prepare title, description and alt text in ChatGPT or Claude. Manual: schedule in your own Pinterest business account within its current limits, or post manually; preserve the kit's spacing and horizon rules. Verify the exact public board and disclosure first.
Logs / verificationConnected: supported readback to state. Lower-cost: ChatGPT or Claude organizes recorded evidence. Manual: check Pinterest's scheduled area and later the actual live Pin; record each stage separately. Missing or ambiguous responses require reconciliation before retry.

Optional channels and recovery

Keep the same checks on the manual path.

Blog / SEOConnected: a supported repository write creates a reviewable change. Lower-cost: draft title, description, section copy and internal links with ChatGPT or Claude. Manual: paste into your site editor, check the rendered page and actual links, and publish only when you choose. Never treat source text as live verification.
Weekend EcosystemConnected: include the optional price-free guide link in a reviewed page section. Lower-cost: draft the soft upsell in ChatGPT or Claude. Manual: add a link through your editor and check the current destination. Do not assume purchase-access automation is active without evidence.
InstagramConnected: use the tested supported format/account under the saved Automatic policy or per-post approval in Review First, through Meta Business Suite or a verified connected publisher. Preserve carousel order and independently read back the schedule and live result. Lower-cost: draft caption and crop notes in ChatGPT or Claude. Manual: create or schedule the feed post in your own supported interface; add Stories manually. Record affiliate disclosure and any required AI label. No earnings claims.
Image correctionConnected: edit only within the approved attempt and spend limits. Lower-cost: use ChatGPT or Claude to identify an exact correction before spending. Manual: fix the layout in your editor or replace it with permitted original imagery. Keep a failed look as a draft; no surprise paid retries.
Cancellation / removalConnected: use a supported cancellation/removal action and read back the result. Lower-cost: ask ChatGPT or Claude to organize the affected IDs and checklist. Manual: cancel the scheduled Pin or remove the live Pin in Pinterest yourself, then record evidence. Deleting a publisher record is not proof that a live Pin was removed.
Missed or partial runConnected: reconcile the existing records before resuming. Lower-cost: have ChatGPT or Claude identify unfinished steps from your log. Manual: complete only the missing steps or sibling Pin. Never repeat an ambiguous publisher create without checking what actually happened.

Every path keeps rights, budget, disclosure, public-board checks and mode-specific authorization. Scheduling needs publisher readback or native confirmation; publication requires a live result. Review 12_STATE_SCHEMA.md for the evidence fields.

14
Automatic setup authorization

Authorize once.
Verify every run.

Your saved policy

During setup, choose Automatic or Review First. Automatic requires your explicit authorization covering accounts, exact boards and sections, destinations, image provider and model, generation budget and period, look pace, channels, schedule, time zone and an end date or revocation condition. Setup records that policy in MY_RECIPE.txt and structured state. Missing authorization never becomes automatic permission.

What happens after setup

For complete customer-supplied product rows, the connected task generates, checks and records the images and copy, publishes the complete blog when selected, schedules passing Pins and reads back the results. It records a fingerprint of every exact output under your policy without asking for ordinary per-image or per-post approval. Changed output runs through the checks again. New accounts, models, destination scope or spending limits require renewed setup authorization.

Recovery and exceptions

The task records write intent before an external action. An unknown outcome requires reconciliation before retry. It resumes missing work and checks actual live publication separately from scheduling. Missing inputs or capabilities are recorded; independent eligible work continues. Essential login, reauthentication or security verification can require you. No subscription, upgrade or security bypass is authorized by this guide.

Customer-supplied sourcing remains a prerequisite. Automatic execution is proven only by a separate actual scheduled run and verified live results. A saved prompt or completed draft is not that proof.

Save credits. Review First and the manual alternatives on pages 12 and 13 remain available. Run planning and copy in ChatGPT or Claude, generate directly, and schedule yourself.
